To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the subject position of the elite athlete is one of exploitation and interchangeability.

the athlete is exploited and relatively powerless in their chosen field of endeavor because of the reserve Army of athletes attempting to compete at the elite level and that the exploitation continues with the athlete being solely responsible for their performance enhancing drugs status and the burden of injury.
elite athletes are a widget within the capitalist machine of modern sport.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the subjectivity of elite athletes and the social conditions that create the athlete subject.
the social and cultural aspects of sport and the way sport is organized and controlled in the modern era.
the exploitation of the athlete as a widget, a cog in the machine of sport.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the elite athlete position in sport has been reduced to that of a widget in the capitalist sport machine.
the athlete as widget is the result of the exploitation of the reserve army in the sport system.
elite athletes are widgets in the sport machine and are exploited for their labour.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the athlete is an exploited worker in the capitalist system.
elite sport is an exploitative system that is driven by the commercial interests of a small group of stakeholders.
sport is not a meritocracy and that the subject position of the elite athlete is not one of privilege but of exploitation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the athlete is a widget in the sport machine, and the sport machine is the engine of capitalism.
the elite athlete is exploited, and this exploitation is a key component in understanding elite sport.
the athlete is a widget, a replaceable part in the commercialized sporting machine.
